task_specification.objective: Make the arena spatially trustworthy under normal traversal, remove Result debug copy while preserving a complete authored upgrade-choice interface, and deliver bounded representative final-wave gameplay ready for native-renderer qualification without regressing boot, input, retry, or preserved assets.

diagnosis.root_cause: The arena defect persists because authored-world scale, product-owned collision, camera limits, visibility-query layers, and occluder-to-visual bindings do not operate as one spatial contract; repeated camera transform tuning cannot repair that ownership split. The Result presenter directly exposes an internal provenance filename. The preserved upgrade shell already has useful authored elements, but the same-loop capability requires its complete visual decision contract to be explicit and regression-safe. Dense profiling support exists, yet usable final-wave performance still depends on bounding real enemy, targeting, presentation, lighting, pickup, weapon, and audio work rather than adding qualification-only telemetry.

stop_conditions: Stop if the arena repair would edit, split, duplicate, reposition, or replace individual meshes within the preserved authored cemetery package.
Reject another camera-only transform treatment unless package wrapper, collision datum, landmark bindings, visibility-query isolation, and camera limits are repaired as one contract.
Do not claim dense-performance success from llvmpipe, an empty arena, incomplete sample windows, diagnostic preparation alone, or fewer than three representative native-renderer retry cycles.
Stop if Result cleanup removes Credits & Notices attribution, upgrade values disagree with authoritative projections, or held confirmation can apply more than one choice.

strategy.rationale: Use three independent implementation families: authoritative wrapper and visibility-binding repair for the repeated arena issue, direct source-presenter repair plus explicit choice hierarchy acceptance for the shell issue, and bounded gameplay scheduling for the required dense-wave increment. This keeps both active issues directly retestable while preserving the accepted authored map and working interaction routes.

code: Import and parse every changed GDScript, scene, and resource under Godot 4.7; require clean editor and runtime logs plus passing native-project and host-boot checks.
Exercise upgrade projection with new-weapon, ranked, unchanged, malformed, and placeholder inputs; assert at most three truthful rendered deltas and exactly-once authoritative application.
Inspect the cemetery contract for one intact package, aligned visual and playable rectangles, valid landmark and perimeter collision, isolated camera-query layers, and restoration of faded visuals.
Assert dense schedulers, pools, profile guards, sample caps, generation checks, and reset receipts remain bounded and release-safe.
runtime: Tester replays keyboard and gamepad-equivalent movement and dash from spawn around the central building and every perimeter approach while checking collision, camera state, landmark visibility, pause, and resume.

Tester exercises a real upgrade draft with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad plus fresh failure and victory Results, verifying the complete visual hierarchy, truthful values, one selection, clean replay, and no debug provenance copy.

GameLoop Runtime recaptures the representative final wave at 1920×1080 on a native renderer with 25–40 enemies and all required systems, then repeats three complete retries and records frame distributions, coverage, lifecycle deltas, and errors.
Regression patrol replays title confirmation, physical-key movement, Escape pause/resume, failure Retry run-serial increment, and return to a clean active run.
visual: Compare spawn, critical-route, four cardinal/perimeter, and central-building traversal views against the reference’s high-angle framing, external depth, clear escape lanes, warm/cool hierarchy, and unobscured silhouettes.

Inspect upgrade choices and both Result outcomes at native viewport, fullscreen, windowed mode, and supported UI scales; require silhouettes or icons, readable current-to-new values, complete focus states, and no debug labels.

Inspect representative dense-combat frames containing the boss, enemy cohort, all weapons, pickups, VFX, lights, and compact HUD; reject missing systems, hidden telegraphs, placeholders, or reduced clarity used to manufacture performance.

done_when: An ordinary movement replay follows a readable loop and cross-route around the central building and reaches all four perimeter approaches, proving larger traversable scale and coherent external world depth beyond each boundary.
The central building, keeper post, cracked bell, tall trees, and perimeter have aligned collision; movement and dash neither pass through visible solids nor strike invisible barriers.
The Warden, nearby threats, hostile telegraphs, and an escape lane remain visible beside every landmark, without landmark disappearance, recurring player occlusion, black void, or camera-mode drift.

Runtime state reports one intact authored package, aligned playable and visual rectangles, external depth on all edges, valid landmark and perimeter collision bindings, and camera queries isolated from gameplay-only bodies.
Keyboard and gamepad-equivalent movement, collision sliding, facing, dash anticipation, invulnerability, recovery, cooldown, pause, and resume remain authoritative after the repair.
tasks.instructions: Use a materially different wrapper/binding strategy instead of further transform tuning. Expand the traversable arena only across native walkable streets in the intact package, preserve a coherent non-playable external world, and unify wrapper scale, outer datum, spawn/navigation anchors, central building and landmark collision, perimeter bodies, camera limits, and occluder visual bindings. Isolate camera visibility queries from ground and gameplay collision, and restore every directly bound visual when obstruction clears. Do not alter imported children. Asset plan: family_id=authored_cemetery_environment; prd_style_match=moonlit stylized cemetery; source_quality_class=accepted intact authored environment; material_and_texture_evidence=preserved runtime validation; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=sole authoritative world; minimum_distinct_source_variants=1; minimum_runtime_variants=1; maximum_single_variant_share=1.0; diversity_axes=native internal terrain, streets, structures, props, and landmarks; background_mode=opaque terrain with external depth; runtime_evidence_views=spawn, critical route, four perimeter approaches, central-building collision, and landmark traversal.
tasks.title: Expand arena scale and unify landmark collision, perimeter, and camera visibility

done_when: Failure and victory Result pages show authored statistics and build summaries without ASSET_PROVENANCE.JSON, provenance-verification wording, calibration copy, or any other raw filename; Credits & Notices retains inspectable attribution.

The choice hierarchy replaces text-stacked choices with silhouettes or icons, compact stat icons, restrained copy, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas per choice.
Unchanged and exhaustive stat rows are absent, and NEW, LOCKED, UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN, or equivalent placeholders never appear in the CURRENT value column.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states are complete and visually distinct for focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, newly unlocked, and selected choices without resizing cards or hiding tradeoffs.
Held confirm applies exactly one authoritative upgrade before gameplay resumes, while cancel, Result, Retry, and later drafts clear stale latches and focus state.
Upgrade and Result layouts remain legible and fully composed at the native viewport, fullscreen, windowed mode, and every supported UI scale.
tasks.instructions: Remove the internal provenance-manifest literal from the Result presenter while retaining detailed licenses and provenance on Credits & Notices. Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy: lead every choice with weapon or upgrade silhouettes or icons, show compact stat icons and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, never show NEW or LOCKED in the CURRENT value column, omit unchanged or exhaustive rows, keep copy restrained, and provide complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states. Preserve the existing authoritative projection, pre-await input latch, exactly-once application, apply-before-unpause transaction, authored icon family, and full-viewport composition. Retest new-weapon and ranked-upgrade offers plus both Result outcomes.
tasks.title: Clean Result copy and complete the upgrade choice visual hierarchy

done_when: Representative final-wave play supports 25–40 ordinary enemies, the Bellkeeper, all three weapons, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, HUD, and audio without losing automatic-attack causality, pickup feedback, boss telegraphs, movement, or dash response.

Steering, neighbor queries, targeting, vitality presentation, animation, optional effects, lights, projectiles, pickups, and audio use explicit caps or deterministic budgets with observable active, skipped, pooled, and high-water counts.
At 1920×1080 on the designated native renderer, three representative complete-run retry cycles produce complete sample windows and stable frame-time distributions consistent with the 60 FPS target.
After each retry, live nodes, callbacks, input actions, enemies, projectiles, pickups, effects, lights, audio voices, attack owners, and memory do not grow without bound.
Profile prepare, advance, and reset remain separate editor-guarded operations; disabled profiling has no release impact, and diagnostic setup is never recorded as an ordinary completed route.
tasks.instructions: Advance usable final-wave behavior by bounding actual dense gameplay work rather than adding an evidence-only layer. Consolidate deterministic scheduling and pooling around the existing dense contract. Prioritize the player, current target, boss, dangerous telegraphs, recent damage, and nearby pickups; stagger only lower-priority steering, neighbor, vitality, animation, light, and optional presentation work without changing authoritative combat or reward timing. Preserve the visible 25–40-enemy workload and all three weapon identities. Keep the native-renderer gate and separate prepare, advance, and reset lifecycle, while exposing complete workload coverage, subsystem high-water marks, skips, caps, sample windows, and reset isolation for host recapture.
tasks.title: Bound representative final-wave runtime work
